summary: Today brings a mixed legal and retail briefing, driven by high court trademark protections and strong retail earnings updates. Key highlights include legal rulings on brand IP and state appointment laws alongside portfolio expansions from major consumer players.

bullets.text: The Kerala High Court upheld interim legal relief for Wipro in a trademark dispute over the 'Brahmins' sambar powder brand.
The Supreme Court struck down a Karnataka law enacted to protect tainted appointments, questioning a previous High Court order.
Asian Paints reported a 7% YoY rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 1,068 crore and declared a Rs 5.75 per share dividend.
Reliance Consumer expanded its fast-moving consumer goods portfolio by introducing Joyland Dairy Drinks into its product lineup.
Quick commerce platforms accounted for 61% of combined beauty sales across q-commerce and Amazon in September, up from 44% last year.
